narrative: Cognition's retirement of Windsurf for Devin Desktop ships the open Agent Client Protocol as the default surface, hosting Codex, Claude Agent, OpenCode and a team's in-house agents while a Rust-rewritten Devin Local replaces Cascade - the vendor competing on the host surface and protocol rather than rebuilding the runtime, which is the open-core-wrapped-in-proprietary-governance inversion the thesis tracks.
remaining_gap: This sits in the coding-agent tier on the ACP protocol, not a named enterprise vendor disclosing a tracked open harness as the engine inside a branded first-party agent.
